description: This file defines the EmployeeBulkLeaveRequestAPI class, which provides bulk operations (approve, cancel, reject) on leave requests through a REST API endpoint. It includes methods for updating leave request statuses in bulk, with appropriate validation and transaction management. The class extends an Endpoint and implements ResourceEndpoint, utilizing various traits for handling leave requests, permissions, and user roles.
